3090056.guide_summary: One SOLD result inside 24 months for the same edition: AUD 6,500 hammer at Australian Book Auctions, Melbourne, 15 May 2024 (Sale 111, lot 97), a copy rebound in later speckled calf, estimate $3,000/6,000. Dealer asks for original-cloth copies are AUD 9,570 and 10,048 and AUD 3,950 for a rebound one. Lesser Boldrewood three-deckers in original cloth made $1,100 and $1,500 at ABA in 2021. Davidson Auctions' archive and Leski's site have no copy; the 2013 Sotheby's result is behind a login. Earlier searches by the research agents found no auction sale; this one came from reading the ABA catalogue and price-list PDFs.
3090056.working: Same edition SOLD inside 24 months: AUD 6,500 hammer (ABA Sale 111, lot 97, 15 May 2024, rebound in later calf). Keep: 6,500 / 1.22 = 5,327, rounded down to $5,300 hammer ($6,466 all-in). Flip: 6,500 / 2.44 = 2,663, rounded down to $2,650 ($3,233 all-in), which leaves room for a specialist auction's commission and the risk that this copy is faulty. The comp is a rebound copy; lot 39 is in the original publisher's cloth, which collectors prefer, so the keep figure is conservative if the set proves complete and sound, and too high if a volume is a later printing, leaves are missing or the hinges are broken. The maximum applies only after the viewing checks pass. | VIEWING 19 OCT (owner's photos): the $6,500 comp was a sound rebound calf set. This copy is in original green cloth (title pages of vols II and III read 'Bolderwood', Remington 1888, with Remington adverts, so it is the first edition), but all three front hinges are cracked with the mull showing, spine ends are frayed, the endpapers and half-titles are foxed (vol II badly), and vol I appears to open straight onto Chapter I with no half-title or title leaf in the photos. It is NOT close in condition to the comp, so the $5,300 keep figure is a ceiling for a complete, sound set only. No sold comp for a worn or incomplete copy was found.
3090056.confidence_reason: The 1888 Remington title page and the original cloth were read in the photos (vol. II only). One verified Australian SOLD result for the same edition inside 24 months, read from the house's own price list; binding differs (rebound comp, original cloth here).
3090056.question_for_armitage: Please confirm all three volumes are the 1888 Remington edition (vols I and III title pages dated 1888), whether the half-titles and publisher's adverts are present and any leaves are missing, the state of the inner hinges and sewing, and whether the cloth has been recased or repaired. Any bookplates or library stamps?
3090056.key_photo_findings: Vol. II title page read: 'Robbery Under Arms ... by Rolf Bolderwood, Three Volumes, Vol II, London, Remington and Co Publishers, Henrietta Street Covent Garden, 1888 [All Rights Reserved]', Remington advert on the facing page. Original green cloth, front covers blocked in black with a flower and butterfly design, spines gilt. Vols I and III not opened in the photos.
